prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset: one uncolored environment line drawing for a quiet Chinese historical visual novel; an empty riverfront street shortly before a magical boat appears. No people, no boat, no magic yet.
Create a single 1920x1080 landscape image, 16:9.

Actual photographic references:
Image 1 (Phoenix/Tuojiang) is the primary spatial reference. Closely study the uneven house frontages, masonry river retaining wall, a flight of real stone steps descending to a small low waterside landing, and the continuous waterline. Preserve that physically credible connection. Do not merely turn the whole photo into an edge filter.
Image 2 (Zhenyuan) only supports varied building widths/heights and a nearby wooded hill rising directly beyond town. Do not copy its modern concrete towers or signs.
This is an artistic recomposition from those photos, not a survey reconstruction. Mirror the bank orientation and move the camera onto a widened near-bank street.

Composition: camera about 2 metres above the near-bank street, looking along a gentle river bend; natural normal-wide perspective, not an aerial view. In the left half, a short row of 4-6 modest old timber and plaster shop houses, mostly two storeys, different bay widths and slightly staggered facades and roof ridges. Ground-floor doors actually meet the dry paved street. Street runs from foreground left/centre toward mid-distance, widening modestly to about 6-9 metres at the landing, never an enormous empty plaza. River occupies the right half. In the middle-right of the frame a single clear stair opening descends from street level through the bank edge to a small lower stone landing at the water. Show about 8-10 usable treads and a convincing side cheek wall. Stair top flush with the upper street, bottom joins the lower landing, lower landing sits just above the water. The main street continues behind the stair opening and does not turn into a flooded ledge. Retaining wall supports the street with visible thickness. Across the river, a few small roofs at the foot of one near wooded hill, with simple farther ridge contours.
Visual language: restrained hand-drawn graphite/ink architectural linework on plain white paper. Clear structural outlines, light far contours, a few selected paving joints and tile indications. Leave most planes white. No elaborate hatching, no tonal wash, no painted shadows, no photo texture, no repeating brick/tile pattern filling every surface. Bottom quarter naturally simple pavement and water, with no key doorway or stair junction pushed into the bottom band.
Mood: lived-in, modest, ordinary, calm, not monumental or tourist-postcard grandiose. Let irregular real building proportions do the work.
Remove all modern air conditioners, wires, concrete high-rises, advertising, mountain lettering, people, boats, cars, banners, decorative red lantern rows, pagodas and bridges. No text, labels, border, collage or inset. No fantasy palace, no impossible stacked roofs, no stairways terminating in walls.
